senses.gloss: (cmp. זחל a. Arab. daḥala) [to be depressed, bent,] to fear, be afraid of, shun; to worship, revere.
units: Targ. Ps. XXXIII, 8; a. fr.—Part. דָּחִיל, דְּחֵיל; constr. דְּחִיל.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 19:30">Targ. Gen. XIX, 30</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 23b:6">Sabb. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>דד׳ מרבנן</he> he who reveres the scholars.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 9:6:2">Y. Naz. IX, end 58ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>מורה</he> a. <cite ref="M00606"><he>מורא</he></cite>, v. Mishn. ib. IX, 5) <he>מה ביזרא ד׳ וכ׳</he> as the grain is afraid of the iron (scythe), so is the hair &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 31b:3">Sabb. 31ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דְּחִיל חטאין</he> shunning sin.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 14:15">Targ. II Sam. XIV, 15</cite> <he>דַּחֲלוּנִי</he> ed. Lag. (ed. <he>דחלונני</he>).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>מן הדא את מדחיל לי</he> with this (fire) wilt thou frighten me?—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1">Koh. R. to VII, 1</cite> (prov.) whom a snake once has bitten, <he>חבלא מדחיל ליה</he> a rope will frighten.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:8">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>אִידְּחִילַת מיניה</he> she was afraid of him.
